evidence: Sentiment experienced a severe contraction dropping to Extreme Fear (24) on October 12, but rebounded sharply by 14 points to 38 (Fear) on October 13. While overall sentiment remains depressed relative to the 7-day average (50.4) and 30-day average (51.1), swift recoveries out of extreme fear typically signal selling exhaustion and short-term relief buying, giving a slight positive bias for the next 24-hour window.
limitations: Fear & Greed Index reflects daily aggregate sentiment and can lag intraday spot volatility.
Sentiment indicators do not guarantee directional price action and should not be used as standalone directional signals.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
